title: Whole-system reduction of inverse open pullback tensor
statement: Fix D,C,E, a higher operation datum H and invertibility of the coefficient prime, together with the specified system operations o,z [def-sf-operation-stages]. For any compactified square Q and constructible M,N on its compactification scheme Z, use tensor comparison mu and pullComparison chi [def-sf-integral-proper-projection-coordinates]. Reduction of inverse openTensorPullback, followed by chi on the tensor and system pullback of mu_Z, equals mu_X on the pulled-back inputs, followed by system tensor of chi_M and chi_N and inverse canonical system pullback/tensor. No open extension, open adjunction, projection or pullback compositor is present.

proof.text: Normalize the datum pullback and both tensor functors using their specified equality fields. integralOpenTensorPullbackNormalization identifies the comparison with canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor. The public canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor_reduction component formula reduces its coefficient square to the already proved private integralComparison_reduction in DerivedPullbackTensorIso, accessed through a private import all. The latter uses the actual Roos tensor and pullback models followed by the reconstruction counit. Identify these maps with tensor and pullComparison, then conjugate by the two isomorphisms to obtain the inverse square.

theorem integralOpenPullTensorReduction
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (H : SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D)
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Q.Z.obj.left) :
    let A := H.integralExchange Q
    let χ := pullComparison H hl o z Q.i
    (reduce Q.X).map ((A.openTensorPullback.inv.app M).app N) ≫
        χ.hom.app (((H.integralTensor Q.Z).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (pull C.l E Q.i.hom.left).map (((tensor H hl Q.Z).app M).app N) =
      ((tensor H hl Q.X).app ((H.integral.pull Q.i).obj M)).app
          ((H.integral.pull Q.i).obj N) ≫
        (calculus C.l E Q.X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom (χ.hom.app M) (χ.hom.app N)) ≫
        (pullbackTensorSystemComparison C.l E Q.i.hom.left).inv.app
          ((reduce Q.Z).obj M, (reduce Q.Z).obj N)
